title: 第十一章  剖技入门狭路相逢第十二章  匹夫之怒血溅五步
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 【每日结算中】
【狩猎灰狼x9、獐鹿x2，狼獾x1，基础箭术经验+5，基础剖技经验+3，力量+2，速度+2】
【技能：基础箭术（小成：650），基础剖技（入门：310）】
【箭术小成：开三石弓，百米之内，十射九中】
【剖技入门：十解九成，各归其位，刃行有痕，尚需目视，堪为匠工】
随着每日结算的弹出，陆川睁开双眼。
关于箭术、解剖的技巧如同流水一般涌入陆川的记忆中。
随之而来的，他的肉身亦开始出现提升，一股股强劲的能量游走周身各处。
陆川只觉得力量澎湃，飘飘欲仙，仿佛下一刻即将飞升一般。
许久后，他深吸一口气，压制住了这种错觉。
此次提升极大，除了肉身的提升，陆川还发现，白天时解剖狼皮的行为，也被每日结算所记录，生成了全新的技能【剖术】。
这也不由让陆川深思，若是他习得百艺，那他岂不是能成为一位全能大师。
但转念一想，一天的时间满打满算也就十二个时辰，花费大量时间在无用的技能上，无疑是捡了芝麻，丢了西瓜。
陆川自身若想变得更加强大，必须要有所选择。
如果有机会学习武道，他会将大部分的精力放在武道修炼之上。
但目前的情况，陆川还没有余钱去武馆习武，他必须先解决当前的困难，再考虑这方面的事情。
想着想着，陆川逐渐有了睡意。
不多时，屋内响起了轻轻的鼾声。
翌日。
陆川难得晚起了些。
叶莞君早早醒来，但她没有打扰陆川，而是放缓了脚步，拿起两人的换洗衣物，在井边开始捣洗起来。
随着时间流逝，井边开始越发热闹起来。
家家户户的妇人围在井边，开始闲谈。
兰姐刚刚从屋里走出，看见叶莞君，顿时眼前一亮：
“莞娘，早啊。”
“兰姐。”
叶莞君朝着兰姐抿嘴一笑。
“哎，多亏了你家的川哥儿，从狼群手下救了我家汉子......”
兰姐面露感激，轻声说道：
“如果你们税钱还差些，我可以先借你们一部分。
到时候手头宽裕了，再还我们也不迟，这是我们两口子的意思。”
叶莞君手中的动作一滞。
狼群？
川哥儿昨日还经历了这般凶险的事情？
她眼中透着慌乱，若是川哥儿出了什么事情......
“莞娘，莞娘？”
兰姐连着唤了两声，叶莞君才回过神来。
她下意识擦了擦双眼，朝着兰姐勉强露出笑容：
“谢谢你们，如果需要的话，我会开口的。”
content_en:
[Daily settlement]
[Hunting gray wolf x9, roe deer x2, wolverine x1, basic archery experience +5, basic profiling experience +3, strength +2, speed +2]
[Skills: Basic Archery (Small Success: 650), Basic Profiling Skills (Entry: 310)]
[Bad Archery Skills: Open a three-stone bow and hit nine out of ten shots within a hundred meters]
[Introduction to dissecting techniques: 90% of the 10 answers, everyone is in their place, there are marks on the blade, it still needs visual inspection, it is worthy of a craftsman]
As the daily settlement popped up, Lu Chuan opened his eyes.
Techniques about archery and anatomy flowed into Lu Chuan's memory like water.
Following this, his physical body also began to improve, and strong energy traveled throughout his body.
Lu Chuan only felt powerful and ecstatic, as if he was about to soar in the next moment.
After a long time, he took a deep breath and suppressed this illusion.
This improvement was huge. In addition to the physical improvement, Lu Chuan also discovered that the act of dissecting the wolf skin during the day was also recorded in the daily settlement, generating a brand new skill [dissection].
This also made Lu Chuan think deeply. If he could learn all kinds of skills, wouldn't he be able to become an all-round master?
But then I thought about it, there are only twelve hours in a day, and spending a lot of time on useless skills is undoubtedly picking up sesame seeds and losing watermelons.
If Lu Chuan himself wants to become stronger, he must make a choice.
If given the opportunity to learn martial arts, he would focus most of his energy on martial arts training.
But under the current situation, Lu Chuan didn't have enough money to go to a martial arts school to practice martial arts. He had to solve the current difficulties first and then consider this matter.
After thinking about it, Lu Chuan gradually fell asleep.
Not long after, gentle snoring sounded in the house.
The next day.
Lu Chuan rarely got up late.
Ye Wanjun woke up early, but she did not disturb Lu Chuan. Instead, she slowed down, picked up their changes of clothes, and started washing them at the well.
As time passed, the well began to become more and more lively.
Women from every household gathered around the well and started chatting.
Sister Lan just walked out of the house and saw Ye Wanjun, her eyes suddenly lit up:
"Wan Niang, morning."
"Sister Lan."
Ye Wanjun pursed his lips and smiled at Sister Lan.
"Hey, thanks to your Brother Chuan, you saved my man from the wolves..."
Sister Lan looked grateful and said softly:
“If your tax money is still short, I can lend you part of it first.
When the time comes when you have enough money, it won’t be too late to pay it back to us. This is the intention of both of us. "
The movement of Ye Wanjun's hand stagnated.
Wolves?
Brother Chuan experienced such a dangerous thing yesterday?
There was panic in her eyes, if something happened to Brother Chuan...
"Guan Niang, Guan Niang?"
Sister Lan called twice in succession, and Ye Wanjun came back to his senses.
She wiped her eyes subconsciously and forced a smile towards Sister Lan:
"Thank you, I'll speak up if necessary."
